decisions.reason: Strongest public commitment through a dedicated page and positive early reception make management reluctant to write off the investment and justify the rebranding.
A dedicated product page signals visible commitment, likely leading management to attribute any weak early results to temporary market development and continue.
Only a website mention indicates limited public commitment and lower sunk costs, but one year is early enough to explain disappointing results as temporary.
Limited website exposure suggests modest investment and commitment, increasing dispensability, though current results can still be seen as temporary.
Merely mentioned on the website and overlapping with a broader grinder make it easier to drop, but management still tends to persist early on unless results are clearly permanent.
Dedicated page indicates public commitment comparable to other featured products, so management likely justifies early investment and keeps it.
